# gravitino_tag Data Source



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gravitino_tag" "example" {
  metalake = "example_metalake"
  name     = "PII"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metalake` (String) The metalake name.
- `name` (String) The tag name.

### Read-Only

- `audit` (Object) Audit information for the tag. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit))
- `comment` (String) The tag comment.
- `inherited` (Boolean) Whether the tag is inherited from a parent metadata object. Null when the server does not report it.
- `properties` (Map of String) The tag properties.

<a id="nestedatt--audit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `audit`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String)
- `creator` (String)
- `last_modified_time` (String)
- `last_modifier` (String)
